title: Velo Crema Nicotine Lozenges
description:
Buy Velo Crema Nicotine Lozenges Online -For Sale

Velo Crema Nicotine Lozenges Nicotine is extract from tobacco by Electrolysis and then infuse into switchable lozenges. There are two types and four flavors of VELO lozenges. Hard lozenges have a crisp texture, are firm, and maintain their shape as they dissolve. Choose your go-to lozenge, then carry on as usual! Around 1.7mg of nicotine are present in each VELO lozenge.

Nicotine Lozenges, VELO Hard Crema

Although these VELO lozenges are designed to gently dissolve and offer the perfect amount of flavor along with nicotine, the term “hard” in VELO Hard Crema 2mg Nicotine Lozenges refers to the physical texture of these lozenges. Each lozenge can be enjoyed for up to ten minutes after you remove it from the container and place it anywhere in your mouth.

VELO Hard Crema has a nicotine content

Each regular-strength lozenge has 2 mg of nicotine and is packaging in stylish packaging that holds 12 of them. In addition, the nicotine in these VELO Crema Hard Lozenges is tobacco-free, allowing you to enjoy them anywhere you like.

Velo’s VELO Hard Crema

With VELO in the equation, experiencing nicotine has never been simpler. With its delicious and premium lozenges in a variety of flavors, the VELO brand is revolutionizing the oral nicotine market.

VELO Nicotine Lozenges review

Although you were probably first acquainted with VELO through its convenient nicotine pouches, VELO also provides cutting-edge and distinctive nicotine lozenges made for authorized adult smokers who love having choices.

The fact that these items don’t require you to dispose of anything after usage may make them even more desirable than pouches. This implies that you can utilize them whenever you want without having to look for a nearby trash can (although VELO nicotine pouches come in a can that allows you to store your used pouches).

Both soft and hard lozenges are available, and each can contain 12 of each type. The soft lozenges are supple and flexible, whilst the hard lozenges have the texture and bite of a peppermint. Interestingly, they aren’t chewy.

How Are Velo Lozenges Used?

Most likely one of the simplest nicotine products to utilize is VELO lozenges. In actuality, the only challenge you might encounter is attempting to open the child-resistant container. Just insert a lozenge in the side of your mouth after you’ve opened the package. There is nothing to remove or throw away after it dissolves. Your particular preferences and how you use them will determine how long you will enjoy them.
